name: RouteVerticalTabs
description:
L3 sections as routes — the default (R6.2): `/settings/security/sessions`. The current
section is read from the location (child routes stay inside their section); every row,
chip and picker entry is a link.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: children
props.description: The section's content: normally the route's `<Outlet />`.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection rendered by the component. Stable identifiers preserve selection and keyboard focus.
